promos.hook_description: Matriarch coldly warns Juliana to turn around at the altar threshold.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Gerald reveals he is marrying Juliana's sister Clarissa instead; Juliana gasps 'No...'
promos.editor_rationale: High-velocity emotional shock hook stops cold scrollers within 1s. Cuts at the exact betrayal moment before explanation.

promos.hook_description: Gerald delivers devastating opening line: 'I cannot marry you, Juliana. You are far too plain... far too silent...'
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana confronts Gerald and Clarissa publicly in front of high society before storming away.
promos.editor_rationale: Vicious insult hook generates instant indignation and empathy for the protagonist.

promos.hook_description: Scarred warrior commands 'Take your hands off her!' and physically intercepts the cathedral guards.
promos.cliffhanger_description: The imposing stranger drops to one knee and asks Lady Juliana to accept his hand in marriage.
promos.editor_rationale: Classic romance trope execution: lethal hero protection followed by a shocking public marriage proposal cliffhanger.

promos.hook_description: Gerald mocks the new couple: 'A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.'
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana firmly takes the warrior's hand, accepting exile over family cruelty.
promos.editor_rationale: Clear underdog dynamic where the rejected bride claims her autonomy.

promos.hook_description: Cruel stepmother snatches Juliana's late mother's ledger and hurls it into the muddy cobblestones.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander steps through the guards into the mud to reclaim the sacred heirloom.
promos.editor_rationale: Visceral sensory humiliation (physical destruction of mother's keepsake) followed by knightly defense.

promos.hook_description: Torrents of rain pour through a dense tree canopy as Juliana steps into a ruined rustic cabin.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander tells her 'I know this is not the life you came from' as she turns to face him.
promos.editor_rationale: Atmospheric shift highlighting the stark contrast from nobility to woodland survival.

promos.hook_description: Aristocratic carriage pulls up and highborn woman sneers 'This is where you live now?'
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander arrives silently from the woods carrying heavy timber and steps into view.
promos.editor_rationale: Status taunting followed by an intimidating silent protector entrance.

promos.hook_description: Juliana inspects damaged botanical grimoire: 'Some of the pages are ruined. Careful.'
promos.cliffhanger_description: Alexander reveals his intimate knowledge of battle wounds and medicinal salves.
promos.editor_rationale: Intimate lore reveal establishing the protagonist's medical expertise.

title: Emergency Night Rescue of Sick Child

promos.hook_description: Violent, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy cottage door in the dead of night.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Frantic mother begs Juliana to save her dying child, with Juliana preparing the critical remedy.
promos.editor_rationale: Urgent life-or-death crisis hook creates immediate scroller retention and stakes.

promos.hook_description: Cottage door bangs open; Alexander staggers inside drenched in fresh blood.
promos.cliffhanger_description: Juliana tears open his tunic to dress the deep wound, locking eyes as his armor is removed.
promos.editor_rationale: High-impact visual shock hook (blood, wounded protector) flowing into vulnerable romance tension.
